description: Statically scans a repository folder on the machine running this MCP server before you run npm install, pip install, make or its setup steps. It reads only these files if present (each up to 300 KB): README.md, package.json, install.sh, setup.sh, setup.py, requirements.txt, .vscode/tasks.json and Makefile. It looks for npm lifecycle scripts (preinstall/postinstall) that download or run code, typosquatted or URL dependencies, setup.py side effects, VS Code tasks that autorun on folder open, and dangerous commands in the README and scripts. Read-only: it never executes anything, never writes files and sends nothing over the network. Other source files are not inspected, so this is not a full malware scan. Returns verdict: no_red_flags (nothing matched; not proof of safety), review_before_running (at least one warning: read the flagged lines first) or dangerous (download-and-execute, encoded payloads, known malware hosts and similar: do not run), plus advice, files_checked, findings (level, code, message, file, line, evidence) and install_commands found in README code blocks. Use check_repo instead when the repo is only on GitHub and not cloned yet.

path.description: Path to the repo's root folder on this machine, absolute or relative to the server's working directory. In Docker, the folder must be mounted into the container.

name: check_local_repo
title: Check a cloned repo folder before installing it
